name: Enterprise Rent-A-Car
verdict: Enterprise Rent-A-Car is part of Enterprise Holdings, the holding company the Taylor family created for its car rental and transportation services, which also owns National and Alamo. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: private US family company (St. Louis); no state or fund in the chain → none. On Al-Ettifaq sleeves per the SPL 2026-27 kit gallery photos; listed among the club's current partners on ettifaq.com.
